    {
      "name": "indexes",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Modifies src/index/txindex.cpp and txindex.h to support index queries on pruned nodes.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.7,
      "reason_tag": "user request",
      "rationale": "Enables txindex to run alongside block pruning, resolving four long-standing user feature requests dating back to 2017 (#10609, #12651, #16182, and #35240). Pruned node operators gain the ability to locate transactions across the full chain history without keeping full blocks on disk."
    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Updates getrawtransaction, gettxoutproof, and REST /tx endpoints to return structured error info with pruned block hashes.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.4,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Adapts RPC and REST transaction lookup error handling to return candidate block hashes for pruned blocks. This provides actionable responses that allow downstream consumers to fetch missing blocks on demand via getblockfrompeer."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Only adds functional tests for txindex pruning and a single-line test runner registration.",
      "band": "Unranked",

      "rationale": "The functional tests test txindex behavior specifically and do not modify the test runner or test framework infrastructure."
    },
